description: This file defines a utility enum GatewayPayloadDecoding with static methods to decode JSON payloads into Decodable models, including optional decoding.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an AnyCodable payload into a specified Decodable type, encoding to Data then decoding into the model.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Decodes an optional AnyCodable payload into a Decodable type if present, otherwise returns nil.
